tool.name: Tradervue
tool.description: Tradervue is a web journal for stocks, futures, forex and options. You import trades, tag them and read reports. A free plan caps how many trades you can import each month.
features: Silver and Gold add unlimited imports and more than one account
Gold adds exit analysis and commission and fee support

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: The help center limits this plan to 30 imported trades per calendar month.

plans.name: Silver
plans.detail: Unlimited trade imports and trading accounts.

plans.name: Gold
plans.detail: Adds exit analysis, max potential P&L analysis, and commission and fee support.

tool.pricing_note: Silver and Gold prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. The free-plan import cap is from Tradervue's help center.
